summary: 11 tests organised in three clear layers: (1) third-party logger level, (2) filter unit tests, (3) end-to-end record capture. All 11 fail when the fix is reverted (litmus-valid). No over-mocking — tests hit real logging.Logger machinery with synthetic LogRecord objects. Synthetic token is clearly labelled and never leaks into transcripts. Each test pins a specific failure mode: level bump per-library (parametrised x4), info emission path, msg scrub, args scrub, no-op on clean records, filter installation point, end-to-end scrubbing, regex shape and false-positive guards.

low.title: test_httpx_info_record_is_not_emitted does not differentiate filtered-by-level vs filtered-by-root-filter
low.detail: The test asserts no httpx INFO records are captured. That is correct behaviour — but if a future refactor relaxes the level bump while leaving the filter in place, the INFO record would be captured with '***' substituted and this test would fail. Arguably that's the desired behaviour (regression alarm) but could confuse future maintainers.
low.recommendation: Optional: add a one-line comment clarifying intent — 'This test pins the LEVEL defence specifically; scrubbing is covered separately in Part 2/3.'

low.title: Regex false-positive suite is minimal
low.detail: test_bot_token_regex_shape checks 4 benign strings. Real log lines contain diverse content (UUIDs, hex digests, HTTP body fragments). A small expansion would catch regression if someone tightens/loosens the regex.
low.recommendation: Optional: add 'deadbeef12345:cafebabe01234567890' and 'timestamp:2026-04-23T20:05:17' style patterns. Not required — security bias is to over-redact.

coverage_assessment.filter_behaviour: covered (msg path, args path, noop, installation site)
coverage_assessment.end_to_end: covered (WARNING record with token is scrubbed)
coverage_assessment.gaps: None material. The tests pin the observable contract; implementation details (exact replacement token '***', per-logger filter attachment vs root-only) are asserted where load-bearing.

fixture_realism: HIGH. FAKE_TOKEN matches the BotFather shape (10-digit bot_id + 35-char suffix). FAKE_URL reconstructs the exact httpx log-line format observed in production QA.
over_mocking: NONE. Tests use real stdlib logging.Logger / LogRecord machinery. The only 'mock' is the synthetic token itself, which is the correct way to avoid materialising a real secret.
